notes: *I will save you no more* divides as rule 56's לֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד precedent directs: *no* to the negative, *I will … more* to יָסַף headed on *more*, *save* to the infinitive and *you* to its suffix. The competing reading, fusing *no more* onto the negative under rule 35, is named in the unit note.

לָכֵן → *wherefore* is headed on the first morpheme as the governing one (rule 23); the competing reading heads on כֵּן as the morpheme carrying the adverbial content, on the analogy of לִפְנֵי → *before*, and either is defensible here.
